payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE before remaining-work tale: Read this epic (no prior notes), all notes on phases .1/.2/.3, the approved child plan and parent phase/epic decisions; reviewed commits f6d3084b, ab32d58a, 8347a46d and actual engine, capture callers, selection/net/rendering source and tests. All three phases are closed; offer_lanes=open is implemented Pending/Next/Ready, JSON remains schema 1, and these commits make no prohibited memory/version edits. No epic-symbol entries; this checkout currently has no symvision recipe. BLOCKERS: (1) snapshot_complete is only consulted by keep-moving classification. Both capture callers invoke the legacy planner even when the snapshot is unavailable, clear unblocked/still_blocked/project_folds afterward, then stage changed_files/new_day_text. A touched-note dependent on completed t plus external q can therefore recover or link from an incomplete graph while reporting no legacy rows. Existing KM31 fixture does not cover this same-note dependent. (2) keep-moving human rows use style_task_status_marker and tests pin raw [/] / [*] / [ ] despite the plan requiring lane names. (3) triggering keep-moving newly pays SuccessorTypeRouting::load/Catalog::load root-note scans; the phase reports about 45-55 ms additional cost and the absolute target miss. FOLLOW-UP OUTCOMES via sase_new_task: .2 note #1 lint proposal declined as already fixed by f490d88f (filter then map in actual capture_pomodoros_agenda.rs; reported filename was singular); no duplicate task. .3 note #1 split by cause: newly added routing/catalog cost remains this epic work; the pre-existing 70 ms close-path miss is already owned by active bob-cli-5w (landing notes #1/#2, .3/.4 proposals, and bob-cli-65 timing evidence), so appended attributed current evidence there, no new task and no reopening fixed 5v/6k/65. .3 note #2 CLI mock discrepancy retained as this epic documentation work: preserve existing destination capsules and make examples match the required named lanes. Searches covered all task statuses, recent-week tasks, and active epics. No proposal was dropped silently. INTEGRATION REVIEW: inspected non-epic commits since f6d3084b, especially Today roots b71a6c15 (exports root_label only; leaf resolver unchanged), MEET starts eda4dfc3, event warnings 273e09a7 (closes intentionally quiet), Work Log stamps 50df0e41, drawer grammar bbd26d97 and multi-note 5ac2fbc2 (shared planner/tracker ordering preserved), and merged routing primitives 675330dd (its active fe.2 still owns landing changes). 39804896 already repaired keep-moving lint/golden integration. Add focused combinations in the repair tale and recheck later drift. No fresh full check or timings were run by this audit; phase-reported passes/timings are not claimed as new results. Keep this epic and parent phase bob-cli-fb.2 open until the tale fixes, verifies, and closes them normally.
